main_text.p: conquæratur, cum patienter ferendo illata, Deum sibi fecerit debitorem.
main_text.head: CAP. XXXV. & Ultimum.
main_text.p: UT vero eradicentur Barbari mores, atque duella crudelitatis plena resecentur, vitæ rectitudini adversa, & reipublicæ maximè nociva; remedia nonnulla proferenda, quibus adhibitis, occasiones duellorum cessabunt, saltem amputabuntur, ne facile in posterum aliæ succrescant.

Nullum autem meo judicio salutarius contra duella remedium erit, quam si qui injurias intulerunt, debitas pœnas maturè patiantur. Et quo magis ad injuriandum homines sunt proclives, eo etiam acrius &c-ala-

page.notes: The word at the end of the page is broken as "ala-", and the line before it ends "&c-". The "&c" is printed and I have kept it as it stands, but I am not certain of the hyphen after it. The word continues on the next page. No marginal notes are printed. The right margin has only stray marks, which I have left out.
